name: Rackmore's Golden Key
summary: On Ranazjar Isle, Rackmore’s Golden Key helps open the chest where a sailor hid his treasure. The Slitherblade naga hold the key among the scattered remains of his voyage.

sections.title: A Sailor’s Cache
sections.body: Rackmore’s log tells how his ship was bound for Feathermoon Stronghold when seafaring creatures attacked. To keep his treasure from them, he hid a chest on Ranazjar Isle. It takes two keys to open: one silver and one gold. The Slitherblade naga hold the Golden Key, while Rackmore’s Silver Key must also be found.

faq.q: What does Rackmore’s Golden Key open?
faq.answer: Rackmore’s Golden Key opens the chest hidden on Ranazjar Isle, together with Rackmore’s Silver Key.
Rackmore hid his chest on Ranazjar Isle after seafaring creatures attacked his ship.
The Slitherblade naga in Desolace hold Rackmore’s Golden Key.

faq.q: Why did Rackmore hide his treasure?
faq.answer: Rackmore hid the chest to keep his treasure from the seafaring creatures that attacked his ship.
